issues.location: research/excerpts.json (chemistry_dm_operating, chemistry_r_operating); propagates to 10 rows of research/claim-changes.json (claim_driver_non_tides + 9 non_tides activity rows)
issues.finding: The two split spans record the PARENT span's contiguous_range_sha256 (716627fa...) instead of their own raw-slice hashes (dm should be d26e03ca..., r should be d4d7df24...). The excerpt text itself is byte-exact to the slice; only the recorded raw-range hash is wrong, so the ledger is not replayable for those 10 rows.
issues.root_cause: verify_excerpts.py split the parent with {**chem.items()} which inherited contiguous_range_sha256; only excerpt_sha256 was recomputed.
issues.verified_by: p4_reslice.py + p21_rowspan.py: sha(text[657:920])=d26e03ca... != stored 716627fa...; sha(text[920:1250])=d4d7df24... != stored 716627fa...
issues.suggested_fix: Recompute each split span's own raw hash; add a self-check assertion in verify_excerpts.py that every recorded contiguous hash equals the recomputed slice hash; rebuild inputs and all downstream artifacts; rerun the full 6-call chain.

issues.finding: The memo cites frozen request SHAs 4454ce57... (main) and 852ba877... (stress). These SHAs appear nowhere in any capture directory, request.json, native-calls.jsonl or registry; they are leftovers from earlier chain iterations that the author itself superseded. The actual frozen request SHAs are 770cd309... (main) and c0c45687... (stress).
issues.root_cause: The memo was written after an early chain run and was not updated when the chain was legitimately re-run (adding observations, fixing the Testing defect, unifying version strings).
issues.verified_by: p18_memo.py + p20_sha_hunt.py: directory-wide grep finds 4454ce57/852ba877 only in the memo and probe scripts.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the memo's SHA references with the final SHAs from native-chain.json; memo hashes must be machine-read, never hand-copied.

issues.finding: The phrase 逐位相同 (bit-identical) is true for the three-scenario segment_subtotal but reads as if the entire forecast JSON is byte-identical to the sealed one; the full-file leaf diff shows 735 differing leaves in confidence/research_adequacy, which is the intended effect of the repair.
issues.suggested_fix: Qualify the claim as segment_subtotal-identical and note the other diffs are the intended role/observation repair.
